parameters.query:
with lead_insert as (
  insert into consulting.leads (
    full_name,
    email,
    phone,
    business_type,
    need_type,
    project_stage,
    message,
    source
  )
  values (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8
  )
  returning id
),
booking_insert as (
  insert into consulting.bookings (
    lead_id,
    status,
    duration_hours,
    starts_at,
    ends_at,
    timezone,
    amount_in_cents,
    currency,
    wompi_reference,
    expires_at,
    is_test
  )
  select
    id,
    'pending_payment',
    $9,
    $10::timestamptz,
    $11::timestamptz,
    $12,
    $13,
    $14,
    $15,
    now() + interval '30 minutes',
    true
  from lead_insert
  returning id, wompi_reference, amount_in_cents, currency
),
payment_insert as (
  insert into consulting.payments (
    booking_id,
    wompi_reference,
    status,
    amount_in_cents,
    currency
  )
  select
    id,
    wompi_reference,
    'pending',
    amount_in_cents,
    currency
  from booking_insert
  returning id
)
select
  booking_insert.id as booking_id,
  booking_insert.wompi_reference,
  booking_insert.amount_in_cents,
  booking_insert.currency
from booking_insert;
